polls.description: China is aggressively advancing its AI capabilities through new models, international cooperation initiatives, and major funding rounds as it competes with the US for global AI leadership.
polls.question: Is China's AI push a genuine threat to US leadership?

cluster_stories.title: Z.AI Completes Giant Data Center With Chinese Chips to Train AI
cluster_stories.summary: Z.AI has completed construction of a giant data center that houses only Chinese-made chips, a big step in Beijing’s efforts to replace restricted Nvidia Corp. silicon for future AI development.
cluster_stories.headline: CHINA COMPLETES MASSIVE AI DATA CENTER... NO NVIDIA CHIPS

cluster_stories.summary: For a year, one question has hung over China’s fast-improving AI models: what are they actually running on? Z.AI has just given part of the answer. It has built a huge data centre that uses only Chinese-made chips. cluster_stories.title: Alibaba open-sources its AI chip software stack at WAIC, targeting Nvidia’s CUDA lock-in
cluster_stories.summary: Alibaba’s chip design unit T-Head announced at the World AI Conference in Shanghai on Saturday that it is open-sourcing SAIL, the full software stack for its Zhenwu series of AI chips. The move is designed to lower migration barriers for developers currently locked into Nvidia’s CUDA ecosystem. cluster_stories.summary: Xi Jinping told the World AI Conference in Shanghai on Friday that artificial intelligence “should not be a solo performance by a single country, but a symphony of international cooperation,” casting Beijing as the patron of open, shared technology. The line, aimed at the developing world and, by implication, at Washington, set the tone for a speech […] This story continues at The Next Web

cluster_stories.title: AI should not be 'solo performance' but 'symphony of global collaboration': Xi Jinping
cluster_stories.summary: At WAIC 2026, Chinese President Xi Jinping called for global AI collaboration and announced support for 5,000 AI research projects in developing countries. China also launched the World Artificial Intelligence Cooperation Organisation (WAICO) with 29 founding member nations.
cluster_stories.headline: XI JINPING: AI Should Be 'Symphony,' Not 'Solo Performance'

cluster_stories.title: Xi pitches China as leader of new global AI order, challenging US dominance
cluster_stories.summary: Chinese President Xi Jinping promoted open-source artificial intelligence at a major tech conference. He urged nations to embrace this technology and pledged support for developing countries. China aims to shape global AI governance and create new standards for the sector. This initiative positions Beijing as an alternative to US influence in AI development. The conference also addressed AI safety and the need for human control over systems.
cluster_stories.headline: XI CHALLENGES US: China to Lead 'New Global AI Order'

cluster_stories.title: Xi’s call on AI, Trump blasts China, US tariffs
cluster_stories.summary: Chinese President Xi Jinping stressed the dual nature of artificial intelligence’s opportunities and challenges, calling for a principle of “openness” and regulations to keep the technology “secure and controllable” in a speech at the country’s flagship annual AI conference. Xi’s first speech to the World AI Conference (WAIC) in Shanghai showed AI is a national strategic priority as China seeks to build greater technological self-reliance amid its tech rivalry with the United States. Earlier...
cluster_stories.headline: XI JINPING CALLS FOR 'OPENNESS' IN AI... New Regulations Coming

cluster_stories.title: Shanghai Xingshu launches first constellation of its space-based computing project
cluster_stories.summary: Shanghai Xingshu Tiansuan launched its first space-computing constellation on Saturday. This project aims to deploy a total of one thousand satellites in orbit. Space-based computing processes data in orbit, reducing the need for Earth transmission. This launch moves China closer to commercial operation of its space-based computing network. Elon Musk's SpaceX is also advancing its own space-based computing initiatives.
cluster_stories.headline: China Launches First Space-Based AI Computing Constellation

cluster_stories.title: China Dismisses Claim that It Illicitly Extracts Foreign AI Tech
cluster_stories.summary: China brushed off allegations that the country distills foreign technology, after US firms including Anthropic PBC said Chinese rivals illicitly extract results from top American models to advance their own capabilities.
cluster_stories.headline: China Denies Illicitly Extracting Foreign AI Tech After US Claims

polls.topic: China's AI Independence and Global Leadership Push
polls.description: China is building AI infrastructure without US chips, pursuing AI self-sufficiency, and Xi Jinping is declaring China's intention to lead global AI standards and development.
